lossy_drops: OWL class expressions not representable as Datalog atoms are dropped
modal/world context flattened to predicate reification
no existential rule heads (skolemisation not emitted)
fluents / 4D temporal-part structure (logic:Fluent, logic:temporalPartOf, logic:Process, logic:Perdurant beyond gufo:Event) have no gUFO class and are dropped
logic: world-modal/contextual structure has no gUFO equivalent
logic:Mode (and Intrinsic/Extrinsic mode/aspect refinements) has no single gUFO base class as a projection target and is dropped (gufo:Aspect is emitted; gufo:Mode does not exist)
multi-level / HiLog instantiation (logic:instanceOf, logic:orderedType — arbitrary type-of-type levels) has no gUFO punning equivalent and is dropped
native builtins (logic:Builtin and the builtin individuals) have no gUFO class and are dropped
native edge-property metadata (RDF-1.2 statement-level scope on logic edges) has no gUFO equivalent and is dropped
only gUFO-mapped sorts and structural predicates emitted
preservation kind is ValidationOnly: gUFO is an anti-pattern check, not an entailment surface
rules not representable in gUFO; only type/subtype declarations kept
scoped open/closed worlds (logic:WorldBoundary, logic:closedUnder, scoped-CWA) have no gUFO equivalent and are dropped
strict-partial-order parthood characteristics (asymmetric + irreflexive on logic:properPartOf) cannot be declared in OWL 2 DL gUFO (it only states transitivity) and are dropped

the five gUFO temporary-situation reifiers (QualityValueAttributionSituation, TemporaryConstitution/Instantiation/Parthood/RelationshipSituation) are SUPERSEDED by logic:Fluent + RDF-1.2 edge properties — not re-emitted by the down-projection
actual: logic:causalPartOf on <https://example.org/occurrent/causal-temporal-lift/A> has no gUFO bridge equivalent
N3 builtins used for arithmetic/string predicates where available
modal context encoded as quoted graph arguments (may overgenerate)

negation-as-failure guards are dropped; monotone log:implies cannot express a defeater, so a defeasible rule is over-approximated (CompleteOver) rather than emitting the guard as a positive antecedent
contextual scope (standpoint, time, confidence) is dropped
modal/world context is erased
probabilistic profile not representable in OWL DL
rule bodies mapped to OWL axioms where OWL is expressive enough; existential rules beyond OWL DL expressivity are dropped

transaction-path evolution has no faithful OWL DL projection: serial conjunction, executional entailment over a path of states, elementary update as supersession, the hypothetical-execution sandbox and its discarded-run witness, and concurrent composition with conflict-serializability have no OWL axiom form and are dropped — OWL describes a single static state, not a transaction path
actual: logic:causalPartOf on <https://example.org/occurrent/causal-temporal-lift/A> has no OWL DL equivalent
contextual scope (standpoint, time, confidence) is dropped
modal/world context is erased
only EL-safe axioms emitted (no disjointness, no inverseOf, no cardinality restrictions, no nominals)
rules beyond EL expressivity are dropped

transaction-path evolution has no faithful OWL EL projection: serial conjunction, executional entailment over a path of states, elementary update as supersession, the hypothetical-execution sandbox and its discarded-run witness, and concurrent composition with conflict-serializability have no OWL axiom form and are dropped — OWL describes a single static state, not a transaction path
actual: logic:causalPartOf on <https://example.org/occurrent/causal-temporal-lift/A> has no EL equivalent
